meaning_en: {path} is not a price file: {detail}. Nothing was read
meaning_zh: {path} 不是有效的价格表：{detail}。未读取任何内容
meaning_zh-Hant: {path} 不是有效的價格表：{detail}。未讀取任何內容

meaning_zh: {path} 第 {line} 行：{detail}。未读取任何内容
meaning_zh-Hant: {path} 第 {line} 行：{detail}。未讀取任何內容

meaning_en: {path} line {line}: {key} already has a row. Nothing was read
meaning_zh: {path} 第 {line} 行：{key} 已经有一行价格了。未读取任何内容
meaning_zh-Hant: {path} 第 {line} 行：{key} 已經有一行價格了。未讀取任何內容

meaning_zh: 读到的第 {index} 条价格：{detail}。未提出任何价格
meaning_zh-Hant: 讀到的第 {index} 條價格：{detail}。未提出任何價格

meaning_zh: {key} 在价格表里没有对应的行
meaning_zh-Hant: {key} 在價格表裡沒有對應的行

meaning_en: {key}: the price is blank (unknown, not zero)
{key}: the price is {status}, not confirmed by a person
meaning_zh: {key}：价格状态是 {status}，还没有经人确认
meaning_zh-Hant: {key}：價格狀態是 {status}，還沒有經人確認

meaning_en: {key} is priced {expected}, the quantity is {unit}. Nothing was estimated
meaning_zh: {key} 的价格按 {expected} 计，但用量是按 {unit} 给的。未做估算
meaning_zh-Hant: {key} 的價格按 {expected} 計，但用量是按 {unit} 給的。未做估算

meaning_en: {key}: the price is blank; fill it from its source before a person confirms it. Nothing was written
meaning_zh: {key}：价格为空，请先按来源填好再请人确认。未写入任何内容
meaning_zh-Hant: {key}：價格為空，請先按來源填好再請人確認。未寫入任何內容

meaning_en: Status {status} is not one trust can be lowered to ({allowed}); raising it is a confirmation through the gate
meaning_zh: 状态 {status} 不能用来降低信任（只能是 {allowed}）；要提高信任必须经人确认
meaning_zh-Hant: 狀態 {status} 不能用來降低信任（只能是 {allowed}）；要提高信任必須經人確認

meaning_en: {path} changed while the person was being asked, so the confirmation of {key} no longer matches it. Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 在等待确认期间 {path} 被改动了，{key} 的这次确认已经对不上。未写入任何内容
meaning_zh-Hant: 在等待確認期間 {path} 被改動了，{key} 的這次確認已經對不上。未寫入任何內容

meaning_en: {key} is {status} now; only a person, through the gate, confirms it again
meaning_zh: {key} 现在是 {status}；只有经人确认才能重新生效
meaning_zh-Hant: {key} 現在是 {status}；只有經人確認才能重新生效

meaning_en: {added} new and {updated} changed prices written as pending to {path}; {held} differ from a confirmed price and are held for the owner
meaning_zh: 已把 {added} 个新价格和 {updated} 个变动的价格以待确认状态写入 {path}；另有 {held} 个与已确认价格不同，留给老板决定
meaning_zh-Hant: 已把 {added} 個新價格和 {updated} 個變動的價格以待確認狀態寫入 {path}；另有 {held} 個與已確認價格不同，留給老闆決定
